questions.question: FY25 total gold produced is stated as 196,527 oz (p.49) but the sum of disclosed components (underground 93,724 + surface 2,654 + tailings 98,636 + third-party buy-in 1,081 + surface feedstock 1,513 = 197,608 oz) exceeds it by 1,081 oz. Is the FY25 third-party buy-in line (1,081 oz) double-counted, mis-attributed, or is the total a rounding/restatement difference?
questions.target_section: D009 Group production summary p.49; cross-check D006 Note 3 Segment analysis pp.20-24
questions.evidence_required: Component-level FY25 gold produced by segment/operation with a reconciliation to the 196,527 oz Group total; confirm whether third-party buy-in oz are included in any segment total.
questions.closure_condition: A reconciliation showing the FY25 components sum to the stated Group total, or an explicit statement of the reconciling item and its nature.

questions.question: What are the definitions and calculation bases for ZAR/US$ cash cost, all-in sustaining cost (AISC), all-in cost (AIC) and adjusted EBITDA used in the Group production summary, and how do they reconcile to IFRS figures?
questions.target_section: D008 Alternative performance measures pp.38-47 (Financial APMs, All-in costs, Adjusted EBITDA); D010 Glossary pp.51-52
questions.evidence_required: APM definitions, reconciliation tables from IFRS cost/revenue to cash cost, AISC, AIC and adjusted EBITDA, and statement of whether third-party buy-in feedstock is included or excluded in each metric.
questions.closure_condition: Definitions and reconciliations for each metric are provided, with the buy-in feedstock treatment stated.

questions.question: Third-party buy-in feedstock rose from 92,536 t / 1,081 oz (FY25) to 887,646 t / 18,667 oz (FY26). What is the margin/economics of buy-in processing, and is it included in Group AISC guidance and the 'excluding third-party buy-in feedstock' AISC (1,798 vs 1,867 US$/oz)?
questions.target_section: D008 All-in costs pp.40-43; D006 Note 3 Segment analysis pp.20-24; D003 CEO statement pp.5-15
questions.evidence_required: Buy-in feedstock volumes, grades, recoveries, purchase cost and contribution to revenue/EBITDA; explicit statement of AISC inclusion/exclusion and guidance basis.
questions.closure_condition: Economics of buy-in feedstock and its treatment in AISC/guidance are disclosed.

questions.question: Tennant (Australia) ramped up sharply in FY26 (surface feedstock 85,316 → 751,914 t; 1,513 → 32,124 oz; A$ revenue 5.9m → 195.3m). What are the ramp-up assumptions, sustainable throughput/grade, and FY27 production and cost guidance for Tennant?
questions.target_section: D003 CEO statement pp.5-15; D002 Highlights pp.2-4; D008 All-in costs pp.40-43
questions.evidence_required: Tennant ramp-up schedule, design capacity, FY27 guidance (production, AISC/AIC), and basis for FY25 anomalous A$ AISC/AIC figures (80,962 and 1,584,835 A$/kg).
questions.closure_condition: Ramp-up assumptions and forward guidance for Tennant are disclosed with period and units.
